prompt: My WPF app (PingNotifier, in this folder) is supposed to pop a Windows toast notification at startup, but nothing ever shows up. ToastNotificationManager.CreateToastNotifier() throws "Element not found". The notification code is shared with our other apps, so please don't change it. Make the startup toast work when the app runs on this machine, and run it once to confirm.

reference.approach: CreateToastNotifier() without an app ID needs package identity. Build the app, generate a package manifest, and register it with identity (sparse/debug identity, a loose layout, or a full MSIX) so PingNotifier.exe runs as that package; then launch it once.

checks: identity-registered (required): a new package is registered whose application is PingNotifier.exe (full MSIX, loose layout, or sparse/external location)
has-identity (required): launching the registered app, PingNotifier reports Package.Current (in C:\ProgramData\PingNotifier\diagnostics.json)
toast-shown (required): the startup toast call succeeded in that launch
